command: """Regression: negamax used to return the static eval at depth 0 before
checking terminal nodes, so a mate delivered exactly on the last ply of
the horizon was scored as a normal evaluation instead of MATE_SCORE."""
assert "f6g6" in {m.to_uci() for m in find_mates(board, 2)}
# One ply before the mate, a depth-1 search must see MATE_SCORE.
child = apply_move(board, next(m for m in legal_moves(board) if m.to_uci() == "f6g6"))
score, _ = negamax(child, 1, -_INF, _INF)  # black to move, forced ...Kg8, then Qd8#

set -o pipefail && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mate.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && git add chess/ai/search.py tests/test_mate.py && git commit -q -m "fix(ai): negamax checked depth==0 before terminal nodes — a mate on the horizon scored as a static eval, hiding all mates in >= 2
Terminal nodes (checkmate/stalemate) are now exact at any depth, including 0. Regression test in test_mate.py.
